name: esedb_query
description: Read an ESE database (WebCacheV01.dat, SRUDB.dat, spartan.edb) as TABLES through esedbexport: list the tables, or return the rows of one, each row numbered by its position in the exported file. It exports tables as text and decodes nothing: a SRUM table is not joined to the application or user it names, a WebCache container is not resolved, and an ESE log is not read. The export is made once per database into esedb-export/<db sha256, first 16 hex>/ under the job's $OUT (or the agent's work directory), with the exporter's whole stdout and stderr in files beside it and an export-manifest.json (database digest, exporter version, argv, exit status, every table file); a complete export is reused by later calls. An exporter that exits non-zero or is stopped by export_timeout_seconds leaves a PARTIAL export: status partial, complete false, the tables listed only as tables_in_partial_export, never as the database's tables. A table name that matches more than one export file is refused with the candidates. A column name that repeats is numbered, and a cell of any size is kept whole.

table.description: Table to read; omit to list the tables

limit.description: Rows shown inline (default 200, at most 20000, an inline page size); every row is kept, and when there are more the whole list is written as JSON Lines and named in all_results

export_timeout_seconds.description: How long to let esedbexport run (default 240); a run that is stopped keeps what it wrote and the answer says partial
